name: FileBrowser Quantum Self-Hosted
free_limit: Apache-2.0 open-source self-hosted web file manager with multi-source browsing, user permissions, file sharing, preview, WebDAV and API; no hosted storage quota or subscription for the software.
watch_out: Bring your own filesystem, TLS, identity configuration and backup; the v2 line is described as beta by maintainers, so evaluate release stability and security before internet exposure. Distinct maintained fork of archived original File Browser.
